title: Statistics
description: What the service moved: per hour or day, by kind and provider. The figures survive restarts and are folded and deleted after the configured time.

chart.title: Data transferred
chart.description: Data transferred per bucket, at most {peak}.
chart.empty: Nothing was transferred in this range.

metrics.title: Scraping the metrics
metrics.description: The service exposes its operational metrics in the Prometheus text format. A token with the “Metrics” area reaches this one route and nothing else.
metrics.scope_hint: Create the token under Settings → API & MCP with the “Metrics” area.

retention.title: Transfer statistics
retention.description: Hourly figures are added into daily ones after the first period and deleted after the second. The all-time totals behind the metrics always stay.
retention.hourly_description: Days before hourly figures become daily ones (1 to the retention).
retention.retention_description: Days the daily figures are kept (7–3650).
